Class StepFacts

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.env.StepFacts
public final class StepFacts extends Object
Ground truth about one agent step, gathered by the mod. It feeds the reward and the metrics and is never part of what the acting network sees.

    • critZone

      public float critZone
      Above zero only while the agent is held for the first crit drill: the distance, eye to hitbox, within which that drill wants the jump made. A jump taken off with the opponent farther away than this is charged as a jump for nothing, whatever the distance on the way down. Zero in a fight: there a jump is judged by what really comes of it.

    • critOpen

      public boolean critOpen
      A swing on this step would have been a critical hit that landed: when the step was chosen the agent was coming down with the weapon back and the sprint off, and the opponent was under its crosshair and in reach.

    • knockedUp

      public boolean knockedUp
      When the step was chosen the agent was in the air by the opponent's doing: knocked up by a hit, with no jump of its own since. A critical hit made from there is a punish crit.

    • cannotAvoid

      public boolean cannotAvoid
      The agent is held in place for a drill and has no way of not being hit: hits taken on this step are counted, but nothing is charged for them.
